title: Ostrakon-VL: Towards Domain-Expert MLLM for Food-Service and Retail Stores

bias_targets.methodology: Performing a vision-ablated check that omits visual inputs to generate a text-only answer, computing a linguistic prior score to filter out samples solvable by language priors alone, and using diagnostic metrics like Visual Necessity Rate (VNR) and Vision-Induced Failure (VIF) to quantify true visual dependence.

Employing a task-specific capability classifier to map instruction instances into a systematic capability taxonomy, measuring the distribution, and performing stratified re-sampling (Capability Coverage Redistribution) to mitigate the long-tail bias toward high-frequency tasks.

Standardizing maximum input resolutions across models to mitigate evaluation bias caused by inconsistent inputs, and replacing the Multimodal Gain (MG) metric with VNR and VIF to prevent the evaluation from inherently favoring simpler semantic structures.
